sermon.title: Does Belief Excuse the Christian from Mistreatment of Innocent People?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks whether Christian belief excuses mistreatment of the innocent—from Tories in the Revolution to modern victims. From Romans 2 and John 8 he teaches conscience in those without Scripture, warns against seared conscience and dehumanizing the unborn, and points to Titus, Hebrews and Ezekiel for profession matched by works and a cleansed conscience.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Sensitive: Tory mistreatment, Darwin/race, abortion dehumanizing, same-sex marriage, welfare, victims of theft. Kept as spoken.

chunks.section_question: What if the American colonists were not Christians at all?
chunks.short_answer: He asks: what if colonists never heard of Jesus—would mistreatment of Tories (property, liberty, happiness taken) still be justified? Neutral Tories who believed in the king but fought neither side were still mistreated.

You see what if now. My second question. Do these conditions. These conditions of mind. Do they justify the abuse and mistreatment of innocent women Tories those were the different government outlook africans and Indians. My third question. Does an ignorant Christian a baby Christian. A grace and faith Christian. Excuse them from the mistreatment of innocent people. Okay does that mentality excuse. The colonists for the way they treated innocent people now you notice I have some pictures up here. We got the Tory over here Matthew lindbern.

He was a neutral Tory he believed in the in the king but he was neutral he didn’t join the revolution he didn’t fight on either side he just thought that the sovereign monarch government was the best and then you got some Indians these are mohawk chiefs this one has long hair if you could see it in the back this was taken in europe by the way they took them over to europe look at all the tattoos he’s got in the earrings tattoos on his face tattoos on his body look at this guy’s haircut man that just didn’t fit in with calling this wigs and stuff and he’s got earrings feathers in his hair and he’s got tattoos right here and this crazy necklace men wearing jewelry and then you got the slave the African slave.

And the colonial woman of course we know they couldn’t get educated they couldn’t have any part of government they couldn’t own property if they were married uh. They couldn’t vote uh.

Now. These people were mistreated by our colonists. Even their property taken away their liberty and happiness taken away. Does that justify if you don’t believe in God that does that justify you mistreating innocent people and if you do believe in God saying you’re a baby Christian. An unlearned ignorant Christian or a grace and faith Christian does that justify does that free you to mistreat these kind of people. Now. I’m going to submit to you some facts today. People that just had a different system of government belief and today we got the socialists and the free enterprise system that is in a war in America. 30 percent of Americans between 18 and 85 that can work are not working 30 percent now I’m not talking about those on social security and the retirement and all that they earn I’m talking about people that can work are not working.

And we believe the lie in the financial page that it’s five percent. That is not true. And listen to this 35 of Americans get government aid the government pays them to do some wrong thing they want them to do. It’s a government system. That that handicaps the product productivity and the inventing initiative and the ambition of Americans. Could that be an amen. We got it today. And people who follow this socialistic work more and more they even saying they’re socialists now. The people of America that are following it their conscience has to be seared and insensitive because you’re turning a people in to basic welfare slaves.

If they would pay them to clean the streets. Mow lawns clean pools give them aid until they get a better job then they could build something in them but these people just said home watch tv. Have parties every Friday night and take drugs and drink and all this and the government just keeps paying if a woman has a child they reward her by giving her more money she has another one they rewarded by giving them more money. So the same thing is happening in America today is what I’m trying to show you that happened and the colonial days and you cannot justify mistreating people. Could that be an amen. Now. I’m going to give you some more facts the conscience can be evil evil just another word for harmful harm.

When you do things that harm yourself and others that’s evil. And the conscience can be evil as many early colonial Christians and non-Christians were Titus 1:15. To the pure all things are pure to them there are defiled and I’m believing nothing is pure. See the people that have a good conscience and want to do right when they act they try to do everything with that consciousness of right. But when you have that conscience seared and hardened so much that you’re just doing evil then you don’t see any reason. To act in what is naturally right. Whatever you believe is right is right to you but even their mind and their conscience is defiled and that’s what he’s telling he said you know they’re conscious whether they’re Christians or whether they’re non-Christians their conscience is what defiled it’s corrupt it’s evil it’s harmful they’re thinking their conscience is harmful.

chunks.section_question: Do works deny a professed knowledge of God?
chunks.short_answer: Titus 1: they profess they know God but in works deny him. Revelation judges by works. Hebrews 9–10: Jesus’ blood cleanses conscience from dead works. Ezekiel 36: new heart and spirit. Maybe we mistreat people today over tattoos and haircuts.
chunks.text:
They profess they know God here’s the Christian part. But in works they deny him. And in Revelation were they judged by their faith or were they judged by their works before the great white throne judgment works your behavior the way you treat people. Being an abominable boy that means detestable disobedient and unto every good work reprovate or undisciplined. Why because people’s conscience were sheared and they had become hard and evil. They had no problem mistreating people. And for 400 years the African American paid a horrible price for 400 years. Now let me tell you something the 14th amendment was created to protect the African.

That’s why it was made after the 13th amendment set him free the 14th amendment gave him protection. Okay. The chinese used the 14th amendment the japanese used the 14th amendment the mexicans used the 14th amendment all of these races used the 14th amendment but when the African tried to use the 14th amendment they were turned down by the same supreme court. They used it. To let other races and other nationalities be free I mean you know that’s a seared conscience that’s an evil harmful conscience and there’s no excuse for that. Amen. The good news.

Is Jesus and his word can clean. And change the conscience Hebrews 9:14 how much more shall the blood of Christ who through the eternal spirit offered himself without spot to God without sin how much more shall the blood of Christ purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God can we have a new conscience. Yes. We’re going to be judged by how we treat other people innocent people not talking about criminals. And the Bible and Jesus himself. Will change our conscience. Hallelujah. Very powerful Hebrews 10:22 let us draw near with a true heart.

And full assurance of faith heaven our hearts sprinkled with the blood of Christ from an evil conscience. The blood of Christ cleanses from all sin it cleanses the conscience. In Ezekiel 36 26 talking about the new covenant remember last week I said 90 percent of Christians cannot quote me the old or new covenant. They don’t even know what the word means. They just know we’re under the new covenant. Well this is part of the new covenant. A new heart will I give you the heart is the mind and where’s the conscience at the heart and their thoughts the conscience is in your mind and the battle. For the kingdom of God is going on in the mind the heart isn’t something down here that we invisibly oh my heart the heart is the emotion of a man the mind of a man and the will of a man a human being.

And a new spirit will I put within you is it possible. That we have mistreated people in our day maybe because they got tattoos funny haircut. Funny color. Wear funny clothes. Maybe they’re homosexuals. And we know it’s wrong but we don’t have a right if they’re not hurting anyone and recruiting and so forth. Are you hearing me. And going how are you to change people if you go around killing them. They’re going to change people if you write them off your list can’t preach the gospel to them.

I submit to you we may be here today. And in some areas our conscience has been seared insensitive it does not cause us to weep when we hear that baby parts are being sold. Doesn’t break our heart at all. That that baby in the womb is being cut to precision to save the head or save the heart or some part. And I’m using that because that came out and proof is here and so many Americans are so insensitive they don’t feel for that child at all. And our hearts are evil. When a person can pre-meditatively set up and kill someone murder them rape them and not be executed for it.

how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without spot to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.

chunks.section_question: Are we ignoring victims’ rights today?
chunks.short_answer: We’re not caring about victims when things are stolen from house or car and if they don’t have certain coverage they’re stuck—belief never excuses mistreatment of the innocent.
chunks.text:
We’re not caring about the victims rights. When people can have their things stolen out of their house or their car stolen and if they don’t have insurance that thief does not have to pay it back that’s not victims rights and we need to get sensitive. To the things that are being done to people. You know we’re usually sensitive to our own mistreatment. And so we rally around people that are getting mistreated like us. But what about the other people that are being mistreated. Mistreatment is mistreatment isn’t that true and somewhere we need a conscience we need a sensitivity to weep over to care about and to stand up.

What I’m saying is there were colonists. That had it right. And they stood against wrong they rose up in rebellion against immorality. And folks we need to in our day and hour we need a moral mutiny.

faqs.question: Does Christian belief excuse mistreatment of innocent people?
faqs.answer: The whole message answers no—conscience, Romans 2, and Jesus’ cleansing demand justice for the innocent.

faqs.question: Were neutral Tories mistreated?
faqs.answer: He says a neutral Tory who didn’t fight either side still had property and liberty taken.

faqs.question: Does Romans 2 apply to people without the Bible?
faqs.answer: Yes—Gentiles without the law doing by nature things in the law are a law to themselves.

scriptures.text_nkjv: for when Gentiles, who do not have the law, by nature do the things in the law, these, although not having the law, are a law to themselves,

faqs.question: Did Jesus use conscience against the accusers?
faqs.answer: He turned the tables; they left one by one by their conscience.

faqs.question: Can funny haircuts or tattoos justify mistreatment?
faqs.answer: No—many Indians became Christians; appearance doesn’t make mistreatment right.

faqs.question: Does he call women marrying women a right?
faqs.answer: He says it’s really a wrong/demerit, not a right—covered by faith-and-grace talk.

faqs.question: What work alternative does he suggest?
faqs.answer: Pay them to clean streets, mow lawns, clean pools—aid until a better job—so they build something.

faqs.question: Are people judged by faith slogan or works in Revelation?
faqs.answer: He asks: were they judged by their faith or by their works?—pointing to works denying a profession.

faqs.question: Can Jesus’ blood cleanse the conscience?
faqs.answer: Hebrews 9:14—how much more shall the blood of Christ cleanse your conscience from dead works.

scriptures.text_nkjv: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without spot to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

faqs.question: Will God give a new heart and spirit?
faqs.answer: Ezekiel 36—a new heart and new spirit within you.

scriptures.text_nkjv: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
